##### Project general facts

Fairmont Residences Al Marjan Island by Ardee Developments is a branded waterfront community created with the Fairmont hotel brand. The architecture is inspired by the natural rhythm of the coastline, with flowing silhouettes, panoramic glazing, spacious terraces and expressive facade geometry. The project combines residential towers that rise above a basement and a ground floor with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, three-bedroom townhouses and exclusive sea villas, all designed to frame open views of the sea.

Residents enjoy direct beach access and water sports facilities, a family pool, a children's pool and an adults-only sky pool with a terrace and bar. A Fairmont fitness centre, a spa with treatment rooms and a steam room support wellness, while a kids' club, a games room, a screening room, residents' gardens and lounges add variety. Restaurants, cafes, a dog wash station, electric vehicle charging, concierge and valet parking complete the resort-style offer.

Interiors emphasise natural light, open layouts and high-quality materials. Floor-to-ceiling glass walls fill the living spaces with daylight, while natural textures and refined contemporary finishes create an elegant and comfortable setting that connects the homes with the surrounding seascape. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a man-made archipelago of four coral-shaped islands along the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, connected by a central boulevard and known for its white sandy beaches, luxury resorts and upscale residences. Calm, clear waters invite swimming, paddleboarding and jet skiing, while beach clubs, spas and fine dining venues give the island a relaxed resort character throughout the year.

The Wynn Al Marjan Island integrated resort sits nearby, and Al Hamra Village with its golf course, marina and mall is a short drive away. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect the island with Ras Al Khaimah city, Ras Al Khaimah International Airport and Dubai, while Dubai International Airport is within comfortable driving distance for international owners and guests.

Al Marjan Island is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the fastest-growing tourism markets in the UAE. Branded beachfront residences linked to a global hospitality name attract holiday home buyers and investors, while major resort developments support strong short-stay rental demand. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai underpin attractive yields and long-term capital growth for owners.
